how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Project Research Scientist I (non-medical) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bhubaneswar Project Research Scientist I (non-medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 05-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for Project Research Scientist I (non-medical) at AIIMS Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Research Scientist I (non-medical) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class post-graduate degree, including integrated PG degrees.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist I (non-medical) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years, with relaxations applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 56,000 + HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email to the address specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves email application, shortlisting, and a hybrid interview (online/offline).

faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
